description: This file defines the 'perf_db2' class, which extends 'adodb_perf', for performance monitoring and tuning specifically tailored for IBM DB2 databases. It includes SQL templates, configuration settings, and methods related to database performance analysis, such as explaining queries and retrieving table information.

classes.name: perf_db2
classes.description: A class for performance monitoring and tuning of IBM DB2 within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database connection.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan explanation for a given SQL statement, optionally partial, and appends tracing information.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves and formats a list of tables in the database, excluding system schemas.
